page.notes: Doubtful readings: "infidijs" (first line, the letters are faint) and "vu!nere" (the middle letter is obscured by a mark in the scan; read as "vulnere"). Long s throughout is rendered as plain s. The note mark "°" in the text is read as {o}, matching the margin note. The right-margin notes read "p Ammianus lib.25. & Chrysost. cont.Gentiles." and "q Ammianus ibidem.". The second note is placed by its mark q in the text before "Corpus", and is recorded in full here: "q Ammianus ibidem." Doubtful readings: "licet" (possibly "licèt") and "cadauer )" with a space before the closing bracket, both copied as they appear. Printed spellings "Dijs", "perijt" and "auten" are left as printed.
